name: Joplin
summary: Open-source Evernote alternative with notebooks, tags, web clipper and sync.
tradeoffs: Sync needs a service (free options: your own Nextcloud, Dropbox, or OneDrive)
setupSteps: Export your notebooks from Evernote as .enex
Set up sync and install the web clipper
